disclaimerBody:
Educational Information Only
Medicaid Pathways is an educational resource created to help families better understand long-term care planning and Medicaid eligibility.
The information provided on this website is general in nature and is not legal advice. Medicaid rules are complex and vary based on individual circumstances. Reading or watching content on this site does not create an attorney-client relationship.
Legal advice can only be provided after a consultation and a written engagement agreement with The Hale Law Firm.
If you have questions about your specific situation, speaking directly with an experienced Medicaid planning attorney can help bring clarity.
privacyBody:
Your Privacy Matters
We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting it.
Medicaid Pathways does not collect personal information unless you choose to provide it—for example, by submitting a contact form or requesting a consultation.
Any information you share is used solely to respond to your inquiry and is handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws. We do not sell or share personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.
This website may use basic analytics tools to understand how visitors use the site so we can improve educational content. These tools do not identify individual visitors.
If you have questions about privacy or how information is handled, you may contact The Hale Law Firm directly.
termsBody:
Using This Website
By using this website, you agree to the following terms:
The content on Medicaid Pathways is provided for educational purposes only.
Information may change as laws and regulations evolve.
You agree not to rely on this information as a substitute for legal advice specific to your situation.
All content on this site is the property of The Hale Law Firm and may not be reproduced without permission.
We aim to keep this site accurate, helpful, and respectful of families navigating difficult decisions. If something on the site is unclear or raises questions, we encourage you to seek clarification rather than make assumptions.
